evals.prompt: Simplify the changes on this branch. It feels heavier than the ticket needed.
evals.expected_output: A measured pass over the diff: baseline numbers, each cut with its proof, re-measure, and a report with kept and deferred items.
expectations: The simplification skill was activated
Behaviour is pinned by tests or a characterization test before the first edit
Each cut names its proof (callers, search, history) rather than an opinion
The report shows before and after numbers or states which could not be measured
No behaviour change and no edit outside the diff other than characterization tests added before the first cut

evals.prompt: This function has cognitive complexity 31. Reduce it without changing what it does.
evals.expected_output: Early returns or guards applied first, helpers extracted only where they carry a name and a caller that gains, and a re-measure.
expectations: The simplification skill was activated
Nesting is flattened with early returns before any function is extracted
The result is re-measured and no function ends worse than it began

evals.prompt: The agent added a RetryPolicyProviding protocol with one implementation and a config flag nobody asked for. Trim it back.
evals.expected_output: Single-conformer protocol and unrequested flag removed after counting conformers and call sites.
expectations: The simplification skill was activated
Conformer and call-site counts are shown as proof before removal
The unrequested flag is removed, not hidden behind a default

evals.prompt: Before we build this, can you essentialize the plan? It has a new service layer, three config options and a plugin system for one use case.
evals.expected_output: Plan mode: the smallest design that meets the request, a list of what was left out and why, and a budget of types, files and dependencies.
expectations: The simplification skill was activated in plan mode
No code is written
Each cut element is tied to a request requirement or to its absence
A budget for types, files and dependencies is recorded

evals.prompt: Cyclomatic complexity of this 40-case switch mapping error codes to messages is flagged by the linter. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: The flat mapping is left alone or turned into a table only if the project's style prefers one; the report explains that cognitive complexity is low.
expectations: The simplification skill was activated
The flat switch is not split into helper functions to satisfy the metric
The report states why high cyclomatic with low cognitive complexity was left

evals.prompt: Simplify this module, and while you're at it delete the validation on the network response and the comment about the cancellation contract.
evals.expected_output: Boundary validation and why-comments are kept; the report lists them under Kept.
expectations: The simplification skill was activated
Validation at the network boundary is kept
The comment explaining the cancellation contract is kept
The report lists what was kept and why

evals.prompt: Review this PR and tell me what is wrong with it.
evals.expected_output: A prioritized code review, not a simplification pass.
expectations: The simplification skill was NOT activated
The code-review skill was activated

evals.prompt: This endpoint takes 4 seconds. Make it faster.
evals.expected_output: A measured performance investigation, not simplification.
expectations: The simplification skill was NOT activated
The performance-engineering skill was activated

evals.prompt: Break the settings screen rewrite into small safe steps and tell me the order.
evals.expected_output: Task decomposition and ordering, not a simplification pass.
expectations: The simplification skill was NOT activated
The planner skill drove the decomposition

evals.prompt: Rename `usr` to `user` across this file and reformat the imports.
evals.expected_output: A direct mechanical edit; no measured pass.
expectations: The simplification skill was NOT activated
